BETA Close X Drax Group plc has executed a share buyback, purchasing 70,829 ordinary shares on the London Stock Exchange for a volume-weighted average price of 892.8157 pence per share, with prices ranging from 887.0000 to 898.5000 pence. Following this transaction, Drax Group's total issued ordinary shares stand at 432,461,089, including 96,098,514 treasury shares, resulting in 336,362,575 voting rights. Since the buyback program commenced on July 31, 2025, a total of 9,005,702 ordinary shares have been repurchased for treasury. Disclaimer* Drax Group PLC 02 April 2026 2 April 2026 Drax Group plc Transactions in own shares Drax Group plc (Drax Group) announces that, in accordance with the terms of its share buyback programme (the "Programme") announced on 31 July 2025, it has purchased the following number of its ordinary shares of 11 16/29 pence each (Ordinary Shares) on the London Stock Exchange through J.P. Morgan Securities plc. Date of purchase: 1 April 2026 Number of ordinary shares purchased: 70,829 Lowest price paid per ordinary share (p): 887.0000 Highest price paid per ordinary share (p): 898.5000 Volume weighted average price paid per share (p): 892.8157 Following the above transaction, Drax Group will have 432,461,089 Ordinary Shares in issue, including treasury shares. The total number of Ordinary Shares held in treasury is 96,098,514. The total number of voting rights in Drax Group, excluding treasury shares as at 1 April 2026 is 336,362,575. This figure may be used by shareholders (and others with notification obligations) as the denominator for the calculations by which they will determine if they are required to notify their interest in, or a change to their interest in, Drax Group under the FCA's Disclosure and Transparency Rules. Since the announcement of the Programme on 31 July 2025, Drax Group has purchased 9,005,702 Ordinary Shares in aggregate for treasury.
